strategies.name: Greed trim
strategies.rule: 100% SPY; 50% once G1 reaches 80 (Extreme Greed); back to 100% when G1 falls to 60

strategies.name: Fear add
strategies.rule: 60% SPY; 100% for 6 months after any G1 reading at or below 20 (Extreme Fear)

strategies.name: Contrarian tilt
strategies.rule: 100% SPY at G1 ≤ 20, 50% at G1 ≥ 80, linear between

strategies.name: Health filter
strategies.rule: 100% SPY; 50% while G2 is below 40 (Weakening or Breaking down)

strategies.name: Fragility de-risk
strategies.rule: 100% SPY; 50% while the fragility overlay is at or above 80

strategies.name: Tilt + health
strategies.rule: Contrarian tilt, capped at 50% while G2 is below 40

strategies.name: AI contrarian tilt
strategies.rule: 100% SMH at G3 ≤ 20, 50% at G3 ≥ 80, linear between (G3 has hindsight and low coverage)
